cues.en: belong to customer segment number three.
cues.zh: 顧客區隔 3。

cues.en: Then this is the prediction region of customer segment number two, where all the wines for which the PC one and PC two extracted features,
cues.zh: 接著是顧客區隔 2 的預測區域，所有葡萄酒的 PC1、PC2 擷取特徵

cues.en: that fall in this green region will be predicted to belong to customer segment number two.
cues.zh: 落在綠色區域，都會預測屬於顧客區隔 2。

cues.en: And finally, this prediction region red, corresponds to customer segment number one inside which all the wines of which the
cues.zh: 最後，紅色預測區域對應顧客區隔 1，任何葡萄酒的

cues.en: extracted features PC one and PC two fall in this region will be predicted to belong to customer segment number one.
cues.zh: 擷取特徵 PC1、PC2 落在這個區域，都會預測屬於顧客區隔 1。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 明白嗎？

cues.zh: 確實，即使是新觀測資料，邏輯斯迴歸結合降維後，仍能很好地區分三個類別。

cues.zh: 也能清楚看到混淆矩陣裡那一筆錯誤預測，就在這裡，

cues.en: and corresponds to a green wine, meaning a wine that in reality belongs to customer segment number two.
